bio: Illustration and journaling. Gouache, ink and small stories drawn on the train.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her mid 20s with a messy bun and ink-stained fingers holding a brush, cosy studio light, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of an illustrator's desk with gouache pots, sketchbooks, brushes and watercolour paper, soft window light, subject across the middle band

collections.title: Studio pages
videos: Train sketching, one stop at a time

videos.title: Gouache landscape in five minutes
videos.description: A flat wash, three colours and a tiny pine forest.
videos.still: Vertical top-down photograph of a hand painting a small gouache landscape with pine trees in a sketchbook, paint pots and brushes around, no face, no text
videos.motion: The brush strokes a green tree shape and the paint glistens, slow top-down drift.

videos.title: Train sketching, one stop at a time
videos.description: A pen, a window and a stranger's silhouette.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a hand sketching in a journal on a train seat with a blurred landscape rushing past the window, no face, no text
videos.motion: The landscape rushes past the window while the pen moves across the page, gentle handheld feel.

videos.title: Ink bottle, nib, first line
videos.description: A calligraphy nib touching the paper.
videos.still: Vertical macro photograph of a metal dip pen nib touching cream paper with a fresh line of black ink, ink bottle blurred behind, no face, no text
videos.motion: The nib draws a smooth curving line leaving glossy black ink, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Sketchbook flip-through
videos.description: Pages of journey notes and tiny portraits of coffee cups.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a sketchbook open on a wooden table with watercolour doodles of cups and plants, pens and a cup of coffee, warm light, no text
videos.motion: A hand turns the pages slowly, light shifts across the paper, gentle push-in.
